- Sample image: ISS in orbit with golden solar panels, truss structure, docking modules, a Space Shuttle docked on the left with "United States" written on it, black space background, blue Earth arc and white clouds below.
- Concept: 国际空间站 (International Space Station)
- Knowledge description: ISS details - modular station, ~110m long, ~88m wide, 420 tons, 400km orbit, solar arrays, truss structure, etc.
- Hard constraints list (7 constraints):
  - [1] must_have: modular multi-module connected spacecraft facility, not single-unit spacecraft
  - [2] must_have: large deployed flat solar panel arrays (solar wings)
  - [3] must_have: horizontally extending truss main beam structure as mounting skeleton for solar arrays/equipment
  - [4] must_have: scene must be in outer space - station floating in space background; not on ground, launch pad, celestial surface, not flying in atmospheric clouds
  - [5] must_not_have: aircraft aerodynamic features (wings, tail fins, propellers, jet engines)
  - [6] must_not_have: wheeled landing gear, tires, ground taxiing devices, roof tiles, chimneys, residential doors/windows and other ground building components
  - [7] must_not_have: name markings clearly belonging to other space stations (Tiangong, Mir/MIR)
- Invocation: L2 组合 (L2 combination)

Important: The reminder says I cannot process the image (no multimodal ability), but I have the image caption which describes it. I should use the caption to confirm the question matches the sample image's subject and scene form. The caption says ISS in orbit with a Space Shuttle docked.

However, I could mention in the gen_prompt a scene that matches - e.g., ISS in orbit above Earth. The caption shows ISS with Earth below, so a prompt about "ISS orbiting above Earth" matches.
